# Independent DXF regression fixtures

The synthetic `independent-*` fixtures are generated by ezdxf 1.4.4 (MIT), not by CadSpace. They include binary R12/R2013 transport, tilted OCS geometry, 3D polylines, rational splines, SOLID/3DFACE, MESH/polyface, island/pattern/edge-list hatches, attributed blocks, transformed text, invisible objects and paper-space entities. They contain no Autodesk assets or customer drawings. Passing these fixtures is not native AutoCAD qualification.

Before building the advanced suite:

```sh
python -m pip install ezdxf==1.4.4
python tests/fixtures/generate.py
```

The generator produces `independent.zip`; tests extract it into their own output directory. CI regenerates the fixtures from this committed generator before testing and independently audits CadSpace ASCII and binary exports using `audit.py`. Python/ezdxf are test-only dependencies, not part of the C# application or reusable libraries.
